FACT-1.gloss: Judy teaches 5 dance classes per day on weekdays

FACT-2.gloss: Judy teaches on 5 weekdays per week

FACT-3.gloss: Judy teaches 8 dance classes on Saturday

FACT-4.gloss: Judy teaches on 1 Saturday per week

RULE-1.gloss: If x teaches n classes per weekday and works m weekdays per week, and n*m=p, then x's total weekday classes is p
RULE-1.formula: ∀x∀n∀m∀p (Quantity(x, weekday_classes_per_day, n) ∧ Quantity(x, weekday_days, m) ∧ Product(n, m, p) → Quantity(x, total_weekday_classes, p))

RULE-2.gloss: If x teaches n classes per Saturday and works m Saturdays per week, and n*m=p, then x's total weekend classes is p
RULE-2.formula: ∀x∀n∀m∀p (Quantity(x, saturday_classes, n) ∧ Quantity(x, saturday_days, m) ∧ Product(n, m, p) → Quantity(x, total_weekend_classes, p))

RULE-3.gloss: If x's total weekday classes is n and total weekend classes is m, and n+m=p, then x's total classes is p
RULE-3.formula: ∀x∀n∀m∀p (Quantity(x, total_weekday_classes, n) ∧ Quantity(x, total_weekend_classes, m) ∧ Sum(n, m, p) → Quantity(x, total_classes, p))

RULE-4.gloss: If x's total classes is n and students per class is m, and n*m=p, then x's total students is p
RULE-4.formula: ∀x∀n∀m∀p (Quantity(x, total_classes, n) ∧ Quantity(x, students_per_class, m) ∧ Product(n, m, p) → Quantity(x, total_students, p))

RULE-5.gloss: If x's total students is n and price per student is m, and n*m=p, then x's total earnings is p
RULE-5.formula: ∀x∀n∀m∀p (Quantity(x, total_students, n) ∧ Quantity(x, price_per_student, m) ∧ Product(n, m, p) → Quantity(x, total_earnings, p))

INF-1.gloss: Judy's total weekday classes is 25, from FACT-1, FACT-2, OP-1, and RULE-1 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-2.gloss: Judy's total weekend classes is 8, from FACT-3, FACT-4, OP-2, and RULE-2 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-3.gloss: Judy's total classes in one week is 33, from INF-1, INF-2, OP-3, and RULE-3 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-4.gloss: Judy's total students in one week is 495, from INF-3, FACT-5, OP-4, and RULE-4 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens

INF-5.gloss: Judy's total earnings in one week is 7425, from INF-4, FACT-6, OP-5, and RULE-5 by Universal Instantiation and Modus Ponens
